en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by al-Hussain b. Ahmad from his father from Ahmad b. Muhammad from al-Hassan b. Mahbub from Jameel b. Salih from al-Fadhl b. Yasar from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
A person who memorizes the Holy Quran and obeys its commandments is in the group of senior angels.”
